name: Greater Republic of Central America (1896–1898)
description: A horizontal triband of blue, white and blue charged at the centre with the emblem of the Greater Republic: a triangle with five volcanoes within a ring inscribed 'República Mayor de Centro América', above five stars.
history: Flag of the Greater Republic of Central America (1896–1898), the union of Honduras, Nicaragua and El Salvador.

features.role: emblem with five volcanoes and five stars
